metadata.title: Retro Soul Portrait with Linear Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a male artist against a vibrant red backdrop featuring horizontal speed lines and contrasting script and sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a man wearing a white fedora and jacket, centered against a solid red field. The upper third of the composition is broken by thin, horizontal white lines and two distinct typographic styles: a wide-tracked sans-serif title and a decorative, flowing script signature.
coreVisualRelationships: White clothing and hat contrasting against deep red background
Horizontal lines intersecting the upper background
Typographic hierarchy between formal title and expressive signature
coreInvariants: White fedora as a primary visual anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies roughly 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white fedora hat at the center-top of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face to the white hat, then upward to the horizontal lines and typography in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample red negative space on the left and right sides of the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white for clothing, hat, and graphic lines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold jewelry and dark skin tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value (white) foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, white, and natural skin/clothing tones

letterConstructionRules: Title: Wide tracking, uniform stroke weight, all-caps
Signature: Fluid, interconnected loops, varying stroke thickness, sharp terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on capital letters in the script
Extreme letter spacing in the sans-serif title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, spaced-out geometric sans and fluid, expressive script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal white parallel lines behind the subject's head

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean look of the top title text.
Captures the elegant, looping, and high-contrast nature of the signature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered portrait of a man with a mustache wearing a white fedora and white jacket against a solid red background. Include five thin, parallel white horizontal lines in the upper third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif title in all-caps at the very top. Add a large, white, flowing script signature on the right side, overlapping the horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant red?
Are there thin white horizontal lines in the upper third?
Is the subject wearing a white fedora?
Is the top text extremely wide-tracked?
Is the signature text in a fluid, looping script?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist's name or likeness
Do not copy the exact logo signature

mustAchieve: Clean, high-contrast separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between red and white
Ensure script loops do not obscure the face
Verify the horizontal lines are perfectly parallel
Confirm the sans-serif tracking is consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Solid Color Background + Horizontal Graphic Lines + Dual-Style Typography (Geometric & Script)
